title: mcgyvr failure notes
description: mcgyvr.failure_notes/1: the record of one failed attempt, built from what the gate, the reviewer or the reply parser observed. Generated from src/mcgyvr/notes.py by `make docs`; do not edit.

schema.description: The record's schema name and version.

rung.description: The rung the failed attempt ran on.

attempt.description: The attempt's number on that rung, from 1.

checks.description: The checks that failed, in the order they ran.

notes.description: One entry per observation, in the order the checks reported them.

check.description: The check that raised it, as the gate names it: `lint`, `format`, `syntax`, `structure`, `typecheck`, `semantic`, `acceptance`, `scope`, `secret`, `structured-data`, `jev`, `verifier`, `reply`, ...

kind.description: `finding`: the check rejected the change. `inconclusive`: the rung ran and could not decide. `refusal`: a reviewer refused a change the gate passed. `unreadable`: the reply could not be read, so nothing was gated.

message.description: The check's own sentence, with the userinfo of any URL in it redacted.

path.description: The repo-relative file the note is about; null when the check keyed it by something that is not a file, such as an acceptance command.

line.description: The line in `path` the check placed it on.

code.description: The check's own code for the kind of problem (`F401`, `E501`, mypy's `attr-defined`, `failed`, `timeout`, ...).

command.description: The command the check ran, when it ran one (acceptance, typecheck), shell-quoted.

exit_code.description: That command's exit, or the exit of the tool an inconclusive rung ran; null when it was killed at the time limit or never ran.

test_id.description: The failing test's id when the check reports one as data; never read out of a command's output.

symbol.description: The missing or undefined name, when the check reports it as data (the semantic rung's missing attribute).
